The strains fed on glycerol as a carbon source to produce isoprene when containing the plasmid of the ara- BAD promoter; strains without this plasmid were fed with glucose. Meanwhile, suitable antibiotics were added to the culture broth with the following concentrations: ampicillin (100 kg/ml), kanamycin (50 kg/ml), and chloramphenicol (34 kg/ml).

Plasmid construction To improve the expression level of heterologous genes in E. coli, the nucleotide sequences of terminal olefinforming fatty acid decarboxylase (OleT)E) gene (GenBank No. HQ709266.1) from Jeotgalicoccus sp. ATCC 8456 and the oleate hydratase (OhyAEM) gene (GenBank No. АСТ54545.1) from Elizabethkingia meningoseptica were firstly evaluated assisted by online software (http:// www.genscript.com/cgi-bin/tools/rare_codon_analysis) and then they were optimized according to the preferred codon usage of E. coli (http://www.jcat.de/). The optimized oleTjE and ohyAEM gene were chemically synthesized by Genray Company using plasmid pGH as the vector (called pGHoleTE and PGH-ohyAEM, respectively). The oleTE gene fragment was obtained by digestion of pGH-oleT with BamHI and Sacl and was then ligated into the corresponding sites of pCOLADuet-1 to create pY/M30.

Using the primers oleT-F (5'-CTAGCTAGCGGCAAC ACTTAAG AGGGATAAG-3') and oleT-R (5'-CTAGG AGCTCTTATGTTCTGTCT ACAAC-3') with plasmid pGH-oleT as a template, the oleT gene containing Nhel and Sacl sites was obtained by PCR. The isolated oleT gene fragment was digested using Nhel and Sacl and inserted into the Nhel/Sacl sites of pBAD18 to yield plasmid pYJM31. To construct the plasmid YJM32, the ohyAEM gene was amplified by PCR using the primers ohya-F (5'-CG CGGATCCGAACCCGATCACCTCTAAATTCG-3') and ohya-R (5'-CCCAAGCTTTTAACCACGGATACCTTTA ACCCA-3') with the plasmid pGH-ohyAEM as a template. The isolated ohyAEM gene fragment was excised with BamHI and HindIll and was inserted into the vector PCOLADuet-1 to form PYJM32. The ohyAEM gene fragment was obtained by excision from pGH-ohyAEM with BglIl and Xhol and was introduced into pYJM30 to make pYJM33. The oleT -ohyAEM gene was digested from pYJM33 with BamHI and Xhol and ligated into pET-28a(+) to create pYJM34. Using the primers ohya-F1(5'-ACGCGTCG ACGAACCCGATCACCTCTAAATTCG-3') and ohya-R, the ohyAEM-1 fragment was amplified by PCR with plasmid pGH-ohyAE as a template. The amplified ohyAЕм-1 gene was cut by Sall and HindIII and then introduced into the plasmid pYJM31 to create pYJM35.
